reconciliation.statement: The outsider authorized exactly the WSOL input credited to the pool vault; the pool PDA authorized exactly the USDT output credited to the outsider. No third-party or synthetic token delta is counted.

limitations: The published IDL is matched to current receipt discriminators and roles but is not a source-code proof of every binary guard.
A successful user-authorized recipient redirect is expected swap functionality and is not an authorization bypass.
No flash envelope is built unless a value-changing pool/config/vault/observation/tick substitution survives.
